generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The Class-IV and Above Contractors who have registered in KPWD / CPWD are eligible in participation of tendering
Materials required for the work shall be procured by the renderer themselves and should got tested by the quality control authority before use on the work.

The Bidders submitting tender for SC, ST, Cat-I, Cat-IIA allotted tenders should upload the Caste Certificate and Domicile Certificate for having resided in the State of Karnataka for more than 10 years issued by the Competent authority in the KPP portal along with their bid compulsorily. Otherwise such Bids will be summarily rejected.
Work Done Certificate For Rs. 2.10 lakhs of Any nature of work done by the prime contractor in the last five years i.e.(2021-22 TO 2025-26) duly signed by not below the rank of Executive Engineer.

To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-2026 (a) achieved in at least one financial year a minimum financial turnover (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only) of Rs.8.41 lakhs. (usually not less than the estimated annual payments under this contract) Annual Turnover Certificate equal to the amount put Tender during last five financial year Certified by Charted account (CA)
Eligible Tenderers will be qualified only if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as per standard tender document.
For other general conditions/ technical conditions/ Other Criteria refer Standard Tender Document
